When parents step onto the mat with their kids, Taekwondo stops being just an activity and becomes something the whole family shares -- a goal, a routine, a memory. Family classes bring parents and children together on the mat. Students of different ages and experience levels train together while working on age-appropriate Taekwondo skills, fitness, and personal goals. Warm-Up Getting everyone moving and ready to train.
